execution_blockers: No application source code or scenario harness is present in the repository.
Design fixtures copied from requirement criteria are not executable acceptance tests until each criterion is bound to runtime assertions.

scenario_contract.mcp_tool_calls: Only registered MCP tools with real arguments and requester scopes.
scenario_contract.workflow_steps: Application, orchestration, ontology, WMS and payment operations use distinct execution identities.
scenario_contract.acceptance_criteria: Verbatim requirement criteria accompany every TC; criteria are not counted as passed runtime assertions.
scenario_contract.execution_readiness_rule: Keep design_only until a harness executes scenarios against the application and system adapters.
